features.userStory: As a browser user, I can open the root URL and access Uncluster.

features.userStory: As a caller, I can separate eligible inline and external CSS/JavaScript from HTML.
features.expectedBehavior: Inline style and executable script blocks are removed into resource lists; eligible external http/https styles/scripts are fetched and successful references rewritten; NodeJS/EJS rewrite helpers adjust paths.
features.edgeCases: JSON-LD; empty blocks; exact rel matching; uppercase schemes; Google Fonts; duplicate URLs; failed or empty fetches.
features.validationRules: Only allowed JavaScript MIME types are extracted; external styles require exact stylesheet relation and lowercase http/https URL; successful nonempty fetches are retained.
features.dependencies: HTML parser; fetcher; path rewrite helpers.
features.assumptions: External fetch failure does not necessarily abort the overall extraction.
features.notes: Derived from current implementation; comprehensive suite designed; execution pending.

features.userStory: As a caller, I can fetch remote text or binary assets with SSRF and size controls.
features.expectedBehavior: Only http/https requests to resolved public IPs are dialed; redirects are revalidated; timeouts, user-agent, redirect count, and a 25 MiB response limit are enforced.
features.edgeCases: DNS rebinding; mixed public/private answers; IPv4-mapped IPv6; redirect loops; slow headers/body; exact and over-limit bodies; unsupported scheme.
features.validationRules: Scheme must be http or https; loopback/private/unspecified/link-local/multicast and listed special ranges are blocked; at most 10 redirects; response at most 25 MiB.
features.dependencies: net/http transport; net.Resolver; safehttp policy; fetcher wrappers.
features.assumptions: DNS and network availability are external dependencies.
features.notes: WebAssembly Go regression confirms independent client timeouts share the guarded bounded transport and connection pool.

features.userStory: As a caller, I can mirror a public page and its referenced assets into local resource paths.
features.expectedBehavior: The main HTML is guarded-fetched, resource URLs are discovered, CSS dependencies followed, assets fetched, HTML references rewritten, and inline CSS/JavaScript extracted into generated resources.
features.edgeCases: srcset; CSS url() nesting; inline style URLs; JSON-LD; collisions; query strings; missing content type; failed assets; absolute-root paths.
features.validationRules: Main URL and resource requests use guarded fetching; only discovered successful resources enter output; filenames are sanitized and collision-adjusted.
features.dependencies: safehttp; fetcher; extractor-like parsing; URL resolution.
features.assumptions: Map iteration can affect fetch order and collision suffix assignment.
features.notes: Five focused Go scraper regressions cover portable HTML paths, srcset, data-script preservation, inline resources, and downloaded CSS dependency rewriting.

features.userStory: As a caller, I can transform HTML into a React MainComponent source string.

features.assumptions: The output is returned as text and is not compiler-validated.
features.notes: Four real Go converter regressions executed red/green in Chrome via a js/wasm test binary; remaining category cases are pending.

features.assumptions: Heuristics intentionally favor recognizable card/list structures.

features.notes: Derived from current implementation; comprehensive suite designed; execution pending.

defects.title: Scraped srcset assets are downloaded but srcset is never rewritten
reproductionSteps: Create the minimal fixture described by the static evidence.

defects.fix: Rewrite each candidate URL while preserving its descriptor.

defects.title: Downloaded CSS dependencies are not rewritten to local assets

defects.rootCauseHypothesis: CSS dependencies entered urlToLocal after discovery, but FetchedResource.Content was never rewritten.
defects.rootCause: The scraper rewrote HTML attributes only and returned downloaded stylesheet content unchanged.
defects.fix: Rewrite each successful external stylesheet after binary localization, resolving url() values against the source stylesheet and emitting portable relative paths.
defects.verification: Focused red/green test and the complete native scraper package suite passed.

defects.title: TSX section generation can omit page content and collapse duplicates

defects.title: Binary fetch creates a new idle transport per asset
reproductionSteps: Create two guarded HTTP clients as repeated asset fetches do.
Inspect their Transport identities.
Confirm whether idle connection pools can be reused.
defects.expectedResult: Guarded clients share a bounded, SSRF-protected transport while retaining their own total timeouts.
defects.actualResult: Before fix every client had a distinct idle pool; after fix both clients share one transport and remain distinct instances.
defects.rootCauseHypothesis: safehttp.Client constructed a new dialer and http.Transport on every call.
defects.rootCause: Transport lifecycle was coupled to the short-lived client wrapper instead of process-level guarded connection pooling.
defects.fix: Create one guarded transport with bounded idle settings and reuse it across per-timeout clients.
defects.verification: Focused WebAssembly Go regression and the complete safehttp suite passed.

defects.title: localStorage exception can stop UI initialization
reproductionSteps: Load the application in a context where localStorage writes throw SecurityError.

defects.expectedResult: The theme applies in memory and the UI remains usable when storage is unavailable.
defects.actualResult: Before fix applyTheme propagated SecurityError; after fix the light theme applied and all six browser regressions passed.
defects.rootCauseHypothesis: applyTheme wrote storage without a guarded fallback.
defects.rootCause: Theme initialization directly read and wrote localStorage even though access can throw in restricted contexts.
defects.fix: Guard theme reads and writes, normalize values, and continue applying the DOM theme when persistence is unavailable.
